g6.why: You show respect by following local rules and listening carefully.

g7.label: 7. The Treaty of Waitangi is an important ___
g7.why: A treaty is a formal agreement; the Treaty of Waitangi was signed in 1840.

g8.label: 8. A dramatic ___
g8.why: A landscape is everything you see in an area of land: mountains, forests, coasts.

g1.label: 1. A meeting place ___ people gather
g1.why: Use 'where' for a place when the clause already has a subject (people gather).

g2.label: 2. A language ___ has become more visible
g2.why: 'That' refers to a thing and is the subject of 'has become'.

g3.label: 3. An idea ___ means guardianship
g3.why: 'Which' refers to a thing (the idea) and is the subject of 'means'.

g4.label: 4. The Treaty of Waitangi, ___ was signed in 1840
g4.why: In a non-defining clause between commas, use 'which', never 'that'.

g5.label: 5. A performance ___ can express welcome
g5.why: 'That' refers to a thing (the performance); 'who' is only for people.

g6.label: 6. A city ___ visitors can learn
g6.why: Use 'where' for a place when the clause has its own subject (visitors).
